## UI-12: Footer

**Figma frame:** _Footer_
**Figma file:** https://www.figma.com/design/BSr242a615D8Lbg6WjT7l1/Use-stellar-design
**Complexity:** Medium (150 points)
**Estimated time:** 2 to 3 days

> 🎨 **Design-only issue** — you work in Figma, not in code.
> **Depends on:** UI-17 (styles), UI-20 (grid). Use styles/grid.

---

### Context

The footer closes the page: brand/tagline, grouped link columns (Docs, Hooks,
Guides, Community, GitHub, npm), the license note (Apache-2.0), and any
copyright/credits. It mirrors and reinforces the header's navigation.

---

### Why this matters

The footer is the safety net for navigation and the place people look for
"official" links (license, repo, npm). It should feel complete and tidy — a weak
footer makes the whole page feel unfinished.

---

### What to design (in Figma)

- Brand/wordmark + short tagline.
- Grouped link columns per the frame (Docs, Hooks, Guides, Community, Social).
- GitHub + npm links; the **Apache-2.0** license note; copyright line.
- Aligned to the UI-20 grid; all text/colors from UI-17 styles.

---

### Deliverables

- Desktop footer + mobile (stacked columns) version.

---

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Brand, tagline, all link columns, social, license (Apache-2.0), copyright present
- [ ] Matches the frame's structure and grouping
- [ ] Aligned to UI-20 grid; styles from UI-17 — no loose hex
- [ ] Mobile stacked version designed
- [ ] Frame shared for review; `Closes #[issue number]`
